title: The Five Mysteries by Which the First Man Descends and Returns
description: Five seemingly trifling human gestures — peace, salutation, kiss, right hand, laying-on-of-hands — are revealed as the great mystery of how Divine Truth descended into self-love and was raised again, and as the same pattern by which every redeemed soul is welcomed home. The five repeat on three planes: rites of the First Man's departure, rites of his return, and the personal redemption of every soul by the Form of Light.
